usedFor: TallyPrime holds accounts and vouchers, and MailerLite keeps subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber” after “No Purchase Activity Detected”.

bestTemplate.name: “No Purchase Activity Detected” in TallyPrime, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A quiet purchase period puts the contact into MailerLite, ready for a win-back.

watchOut: “New Receipt event occurs” fires on create, update or delete, so one receipt can run twice.
